children.value: > Fact From Story: Epic sued Google in 2020 after a fight over in-app purchase fees, claiming the Android operating system’s Google Play Store constituted an unlawful monopoly
> Fact From Story: Epic wants to break up Google’s alleged monopoly on Android app stores and payment methods, so developers aren’t stuck paying the “Google Tax” or passing
> > Fact From Story: Google gave Spotify a 0 percent fee and let them process their own payments, and Spotify kept 100 percent.
> > > Fact From Story: Google paid game developers not to build their own app stores or standalone app launchers like Epic did with Fortnite. | Fact From Story
> > > Fact From Story: If you’re a smaller developer than Spotify, you get screwed. | Fact From Story
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Paying potential competitors to not compete is an anti-competitive practice. | Commonsense Knowledge
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Favoring one company over others can be an anti-competitive practice.
> Commonsense Knowledge: A monopoly is illegal if it is acquired or maintained through anti-competitive practices.
